newsitem.title: UK: Granada rises after UBS upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Granada rises after UBS upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Granada Group Plc rose on Friday as the broad market sank after brokerage UBS upgraded the stock, dealers said.
By 1020 GMT, the shares were up 12p, or 1.4 percent, to 872. They were one of only 13 FTSE 100 shares to register gains.
UBS upgraded the stock to "buy" from "hold," dealers said.
The analyst wasn't immediately available to comment on the recommendation.
There also was a rumour that Granada was to sell its all or part of its 11 percent stake in BSkyB, dealers said. Some discounted the rumours.
The company was not immediately available to comment about its intentions.
Dealers also said there was some optimism ahead of the Granada's annual meeting next week. They noted that Granada shares have underperformed the broad market in recent months.
